new_work_evidence_policy.retail_module_role: match and verify targets already explained by H4EK; never a source to invent a binding

retail_resolution_method.reach_form_verdict: REFUTED for Halo 4: zero on-disk qword (VA) and zero dword (RVA) references to any probe name string; no static script-function table exists in the disk image; Halo 4 stores the DOCS string at entry+0x18, so Reach's +0x18 constant would dereference documentation text

h4_chain.name_reference_form: exactly one RIP-relative lea rdx (48 8D 15 rel32) in .text per name
h4_chain.block_shape: mov ecx,0x68; call alloc -> lea r9,[docs] -> lea r8,[IMPL] -> lea rdx,[NAME] -> call per-signature ctor -> call register
h4_chain.implementation_derivation: the lea r8 (4C 8D 05 rel32) 7 bytes before the unique name lea rdx
h4_chain.runtime_table: array of 8-byte entry POINTERS at registrar_object+0x260, count dword at +0x6264; entries are heap allocations, no inline stride
h4_chain.validation_rule: implementation RVA must be an exact .pdata function begin, OR a .pdata-exempt leaf thunk (e.g. mov ecx,imm; jmp rel32) whose single jmp target is an exact .pdata function begin
h4_chain.validation_rule_measured_thunk_case: player_action_test_grenade_trigger -> 0x000AB2AC (10-byte leaf thunk: mov ecx,5; jmp 0x000AB128) -> 0x000AB128 exact .pdata per-action bit-test dispatcher
h4_chain.independent_identity_cross_check: the lea r9 documentation string in retail matches tool.exe script-doc output verbatim for every probe name, so each future anchor carries a kit-corroborated identity

retail_resolution_method.scope: admits the derivation METHOD and pins this module's registrar bounds plus the entry layout; it admits NO camera, render, HUD, or vehicle binding - each of those still needs its own H4EK semantics plus its own recorded retail match

tool.exe.xml_wellformedness_caveat: export-tag-to-xml writes raw bytes (e.g. FF FF FF FF NONE tag references) unescaped into attribute values under a UTF-8 declaration; 11 of 18 exports on the first full run were not well-formed. Use an encoding-tolerant reader; tools/export_h4_kit.ps1 quarantines malformed output as .xml.raw.

player_view_transaction.evidence_source: H4EK binaries only; no retail module was opened. ALL RVAs here are kit RVAs in halo4_tag_test.exe unless a build is named.
player_view_transaction.array_vs_stack_verdict: BOTH, and they are different objects: a fixed per-player view ARRAY plus a render-view pointer STACK used as the active-view scope. The stack symbols that prompted the question are the scope mechanism, not per-player storage - Reach has both as well, so the Reach-shaped M1 hook architecture carries over.
